scope: Node worker-thread memory model of early worker array-reference release; not browser acceptance
verified: All modes compare every reconstructed number with Object.is, including signed zero.
model: Worker constructs four numeric arrays and matching Float64 buffers. Baseline transfers all, terminates, and main reconstructs. Streaming retains worker arrays while main reconstructs one buffer at a time. Stream-release drops each worker array reference before sending its buffer; no explicit garbage collection is requested.
limitations: Node synthetic worker model is not Chromium or an application memory test.
Dropping a reference does not prove its allocation was collected or returned to the operating system.
No aliases, source graph traversal, old project, validation failures, cancellation or compressed data are modeled.
A different representation, ownership scheme or garbage-collection timing remains untested.
